I do not plan to irrigate, and I will not use chemical fertilizer on this plot because cash is tight and beans can still do reasonably well without much nitrogen. I will keep using my local seed, but I will spray for pests because insects can damage beans badly here, and I expect my family to do most of the work with only a little hired help.
